title: Tailscale
description: Online devices by default, offline checkbox and collapsed filter. Unknown stays unknown; collector failure is not device offline. No machine keys, peer keys, routes or user IDs are exported. Requires the included Python collector on a signed-in Tailscale host; shows host-visible peers rather than a full administrative tailnet inventory. Setup: see this package's INSTALL.md in the public source release. Add an approved public source URL before submitting. Configure actual service URLs and credentials locally after import; never upload them to Workshop.
changelog: Initial public release; portable example URLs and documented local setup.
